summary: Explain contexts, modules and symbol loading so multi-file device code and JIT workflows can be debugged deliberately.
outcomes: Trace runtime and driver responsibilities for context and module lifetime.
Build separately compiled device code with explicit architecture targets.
sequence: Trace a normal runtime launch to its device module.
Compare primary/context ownership and API layers.
Split device code across translation units and link it.
Introduce runtime compilation, JIT caching and binary compatibility.
Diagnose missing kernels, symbols and unsupported targets.

visual.question: Which context owns the module and allocation used by this launch?
visual.interaction: Load/unload modules and expose invalid lifetime or context edges.

practice.task: Build a multi-file kernel library and diagnose a JIT failure.
practice.success: Clean build and launch succeed; context, target and module assumptions are documented.
